name: mnemonic_temporal_desynchronization
label: Chronal Drift of Self
godotFeature: Custom Shaders (ShaderMaterial), Node.process_mode and AnimationPlayer/Tween speed manipulation, custom delta time scaling for physics and movement
poeticVision: Feel the world's relentless pace accelerate as your grasp on self crumbles, every hunter's lunge a blur of impossible speed. Then, in the brief clarity of a reclaimed memory, experience the serene, agonizing slowness of time, allowing impossible feats before the rush of forgetting consumes you once more. It's not just a power, it's the fluctuating heartbeat of your fading mind.

parameters.name: initial_stability
parameters.description: The starting 'Temporal Stability' value (0.0 = low, 1.0 = high). Influences initial enemy speed and visual distortion.

parameters.name: min_speed_multiplier
parameters.description: The speed multiplier applied to enemies and visual effects when 'Temporal Stability' is at its maximum (1.0). Lower values mean slower enemies.

parameters.name: max_speed_multiplier
parameters.description: The speed multiplier applied to enemies and visual effects when 'Temporal Stability' is at its minimum (0.0). Higher values mean faster enemies.

parameters.name: enemy_group_name
parameters.description: The name of the Node group containing all enemy entities whose speed should be affected by 'Chronal Drift'.

parameters.name: shader_path
parameters.description: The file path to the GLSL shader (`temporal_distortion.gdshader`) used for visual temporal distortions.

parameters.name: shader_distortion_intensity
parameters.description: Controls the overall strength of the visual distortion effects (chromatic aberration, motion blur) in the shader. (0.0 = no distortion, 1.0 = full distortion).

parameters.name: shader_chromatic_aberration_strength
parameters.description: Controls the intensity of the chromatic aberration effect in the shader. Higher values mean more color fringing.

verdict: A temporal heartbeat echoing the soul's decay, this invention masterfully weaves identity into the very fabric of time, making every breath a desperate race against the self.
impact: This mechanic would fundamentally define the player's experience, transforming the abstract concept of identity loss into a visceral, moment-to-moment struggle against time itself. The constant flux between frantic urgency and agonizing clarity would create a unique rhythm of gameplay, forcing players to adapt their strategies based on Lyra's mental state. It would make every recovered memory fragment a tangible power-up and every moment of forgetting a direct, accelerating threat, deepening the emotional connection to Lyra's desperate journey.
